notes: Runtime decision policy is owned by systems/backend/app/diagnosis.
The Model Artifact selected_threshold is the binary failure-risk threshold and caps the operational attention boundary so a model-positive result cannot remain normal/continue_monitoring.
The severity boundaries preserve the Canonical V3.1 independent-logreg risk-band contract for before/after maintenance comparability.
Operational severity bands are intentionally independent from the model-positive threshold: a warning can request human inspection without claiming a confirmed failure hypothesis.
Warning and critical boundaries remain Backend-owned operational severity thresholds.
High-criticality equipment lowers attention and warning boundaries only; it does not authorize automatic control.
Final deployment thresholds require customer-specific cost validation.
